set.body:
Scheduling lane: validation. Current plan: docs/refactor/PLAN.md. Live dependency edges supersede historical sequencing below.

Operative correction: inter-coder agreement is not a mathematical ceiling. Report agreement/uncertainty as a reference comparison; a ceiling claim needs its own justified estimand/model. This replaces any contrary historical criterion below.

2026-09-19 operative acceptance amendment (docs/refactor/PLAN.md):
Extend the existing second-coding study to organization recovery; freeze sampling/tolerances before reads, include real reverse/revisit and repeated-occurrence recalls, permit ambiguity/multiple occurrences, no chronology-enforcement instruction. Measure candidate/localization/specificity and transition/group-effect recovery; independent annotation is not automatically truth.

Current disposition, 2026-09-19; governing docs/refactor/PLAN.md.
Extend the existing second-coding study to organization recovery; freeze sampling/tolerances before reads, include real reverse/revisit and repeated-occurrence recalls, permit ambiguity/multiple occurrences, no chronology-enforcement instruction. Measure candidate/localization/specificity and transition/group-effect recovery; independent annotation is not automatically truth.

Original scope retained below for evidence; fleet procedure/assignments are historical and do not govern single-developer work.

Plan: docs/plans/2026-09-18-best-recall-to-video-mapper.md §3 Phase 1b Human ceiling.

No task has a human ceiling; each recall mapping is a single coding.

Scope:
Sampling plan, blind second coding, agreement statistics. (The within-scene human lane is its own ticket.)

Acceptance criteria:
1. A sampling plan is committed before coding: corpora (Sherlock scenes, FilmFestival recall_scenematched, Friends WhichEvent), development participants only, sample sizes and the precision each yields.
2. Second coders are blind to the first coding; protocol and coder roles are recorded.
3. Inter-coder agreement is computed with CIs on the same task definitions as the benchmark and reported with uncertainty as a reference comparison per task, not an accuracy ceiling.
4. No recall prose is committed.

Gate: every script in tools/recall-study/tests exits 0 (`for t in tools/recall-study/tests/test_*.py;
do python3 "$t" || exit 1; done`), new tests included; a named mutation witness per new guard; no
recall prose or participant text committed (hashes and aggregates only); fresh-context cold review;
the commit body states the evidence and what it does not establish.

Size: L.
set.title: G3: independent human coding and organization-recovery study
